abilities.game_description:
Fire a powerful shot from your hand cannon.

• Deals {Damage}()Damage.
• Mercy can Critically Strike and applies On-Hit Effects.
• Benefits from Lifesteal.
• Applies {Stacks} Vengeance stacks.
abilities.menu_description:
Equip Mercy to fire a powerful shot dealing 25/30/35/40/45 (+74/78/82/86/90%) physical damage and applying 3 stacks of Vengeance to the Target.

Mercy benefits from Lifesteal, can Critically Strike, and applies on-hit effects.

abilities.game_description:
Passive: Dealing Damage applies Vengeance for {Duration}s.
• Deal {BonusDamagePercent}% Bonus Damage per stack.

Purify all Enemies that are marked with Vengeance.

• Deals {Damage} Damage.
• Deals an additional {DamagePerStack}()Damage per stack.
• Slows by {SlowMagnitude}% for {SlowDuration}s.
• Resets Cooldown and refunds {ManaRefundPercent}% Mana if any Enemy is killed.
abilities.menu_description:
Passive: Apply Vengeance to enemies by dealing basic attack or ability damage, increasing damage you deal to them by 0.75% for 3.5s, stacking infinitely.

Active: Purify all Enemy Units afflicted with Vengeance, dealing 45/65/85/105/125 physical damage, plus an additional 6/8/10/12/14 (+12%) damage per stack, and Slowing them by 10/15/20/25/30% for 1s.

The cooldown is reset and 35% Mana is refunded if Dusk kills any target.

abilities.game_description:
Dash in your current movement direction.

• Become briefly Unselectable.
• Gain {BonusPhysicalPower} Physical Power for {BonusDuration}s, stacking up to {MaxStacks} times.
• Takedowns refresh the Cooldown.
abilities.menu_description:
Dash 475/525/575/625/675 units in your current movement direction, becoming briefly Unselectable and gaining an additional 5/10/15/20/25 Bonus Physical Power for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.

Cooldown Resets on Takedown.

abilities.game_description:
Unleash a torrent of bullets and arrows.

• Deals {Damage}()Damage over {Duration}s.
• Lifesteals and can Critically Strike.
• Applies {Blight}% Blight for {BlightDuration}s.
• Shadow Glide can be cast during this time.
• You can move but are Slowed by {SelfSlow}%.
abilities.menu_description:
Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225/330/435 (+460%) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s.

These attacks benefit from lifesteal and can critically strike.

While Purge is active, Kira cannot attack or cast abilities, except Shadow Glide, and is Slowed by 30%.

abilities.game_description:
Periodically become empowered:

• Your next Basic Attack or Mercy fires a Raven.

The Raven:
• Explodes, dealing Damage equal to {Damage}% of the target's Current Health.
• Deals damage to all enemies in a small area.
abilities.menu_description:
Nevermore activates every 15/14.5/14/13.5/13/12.5/12/11.5/11/10.5/10/9.5/9/8.5/8/7.5/7/6.5s (-0.5 per Level), empowering Kira.

While empowered, Kira's next Basic Attack or Mercy blast fires a Raven at the target that explodes on impact, dealing (+7% of the Target's Current Health) physical damage to all targets in a small area.

effects.name: Chrono Strikes
effects.menu_description:
• Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.
• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.
• Only triggers once per ability.
• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.

effects.name: Virulent Strikes
effects.menu_description:
• Shred 3 Physical Armor for 3s On-Hit.
• Stacks up to 4 times.

effects.name: Insatiable Harvest
effects.menu_description:
• Deal 1.5x damage to Minions and Small Monsters.
• Upon killing Siege Minions and Camp Leaders, permanently gain +0.5 Physical Power.

effects.name: Divide & Conquer
effects.menu_description: • If they have no Ally within <EffectText>1000u</EffectText> of themselves, deal <EffectText>8%</EffectText> more damage to them.

effects.name: Spirit Bleed
effects.menu_description:
• Apply a bleed that drains Mana by 30 (+8% Target's Max Mana) over 4s.
• Deals True Damage equal to 80% of the Mana Drained.
• Damaging the Target with an Ability while Spirit Bleed is active will refresh its duration.

effects.name: Solarblade
effects.menu_description:
• Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s.
• Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit.
• Can Critically Strike.
• Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.

effects.name: Blighted Strikes
effects.menu_description:
• Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
• Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit.
• Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.

effects.name: Anon
effects.menu_description:
• Convert excess Healing into a Shield.
• Max Shield size: (+100%).
• The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.

effects.name: Corrode
effects.menu_description:
• Reduce their Physical Armor by 4.5% for 3s.
• Stacks up to 6 times.
• At 6 stacks they become Eroded.
